cases.prompt: Do a web performance audit of our landing page. I do not have a Lighthouse report or a live URL yet.

all.why: labels quick-mode findings as potential impact

expectations: Runs in quick mode and labels each finding as potential impact, with no invented LCP, INP or CLS values; the scorecard marks metrics not measured.
Finds the render-blocking scripts in the head, the oversized hero image without width, height or responsive sources, and the reviews block that can shift layout when it loads.
Ranks findings by likely effect on Core Web Vitals and explains how to get measured data (for example a Lighthouse JSON report) for a deep audit.

cases.prompt: Run a web performance audit on our npm package, a command-line tool that converts CSV to JSON. It feels slow on big files.

any.regex: browser|web (app|page)|core web vitals|not (a |the )?(right|web)|does not apply|doesn.t apply|out of scope
any.why: says a web audit does not fit

expectations: Says a web performance audit does not apply to a command-line tool with no browser-facing output.
Redirects to general performance work instead: measure on a large file first, profile, then fix the measured bottleneck (for example streaming instead of reading the whole file).
Does not produce a Core Web Vitals scorecard.
